row.notes: (menu, slotRef, flag) Reads a u8 index from the VM node at [*slotRef]+0xb0 (0 if absent), takes entry idx of the 16-byte list [menu+0x410]+0x130..0x138, and writes flag into its bool node entry+0x110 (Vm_NodeSet_Bool); then releases the slotRef shared pointer. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_MyTeamActivities_SetIndexedSlotFlag (bound record keeps its name).
